manage.categoryDetail: Maintain naming and classification rules for collection categories, affecting filtering in add, search, and organize.
manage.ipDetail: Unified maintenance of works, series, and project names to reduce spelling fragmentation during entry.
manage.characterDetail: Maintain character names and their associated IPs for fine-grained retrieval and preference aggregation.
manage.storageDetail: Build a location tree with cabinets, drawers, and binders to map real-world storage into the app.
manage.themeDetail: Manage light, dark, and theme styles to make information density and reading contrast more suitable for the current device.
manage.trashDetail: View mistakenly deleted items, restore projects, or permanently clear history deletions after confirmation.
manage.exportDetail: Export collections, wishlist, events, recharge, and presets as backup files with lightweight and custom export options.
manage.importDetail: Read backup JSON to merge collections, events, recharge, and preset information.
manage.syncDetail: Connect to GitHub to sync data across devices and check tokens, Gist, and remote status.
manage.shareDetail: View all initiated share records, copy share links, disable or delete shares no longer needed.
manage.aboutDetail: View version, data description and sync usage for easy reference and troubleshooting.
manage.categorySummary: Start by cleaning up naming, then gradually consolidate synonymous categories to avoid fragmented statistics.
manage.ipSummary: IP is the upper-level semantics for characters, search, and statistics. Stabilize this first for cleaner data.
manage.characterSummary: If you often organize or count by character, this one should be kept most complete.
manage.storageSummary: Location structure is better for finding items and reviewing than individual tags, and convenient for batch relocation.
manage.themeSummary: Larger screens suit clearer hierarchy and lower-noise colors; smaller screens prioritize tap recognition.
manage.trashSummary: When trash items keep growing, it may indicate the daily organization workflow needs to be smoother.
manage.exportEntrySummary: Backup should be a low-effort daily action, not an afterthought when problems arise.
manage.importSummary: Import is a high-impact operation; the entry should be clear and feedback should be direct enough.
manage.syncSummary: The sync page should lean towards a status center rather than a one-time action page, focusing on seeing 'is it safe now'.
manage.shareSummary: Centralize share management to avoid too many invalid links scattered around.
manage.aboutSummary: The about page should take on the responsibility of 'reducing questions', not just displaying version numbers.
manage.categoryRecommendation: If category count is growing, prioritize unifying main categories first, then handle sub-tags.
manage.ipRecommendation: Consider merging different spellings of the same series first, then fill in common abbreviations.
manage.characterRecommendation: Prioritize filling in high-frequency characters first, then clean up low-frequency or duplicate entries.
manage.storageRecommendation: Build out the first and second level structures first, then gradually fill in specific slots.
manage.themeRecommendation: Try viewing on your commonly used devices to confirm contrast and whitespace are stable.
manage.trashRecommendation: Regularly clean up records with no long-term recovery value to keep the state lightweight.
manage.exportRecommendation: Consider doing a lightweight export before major preset changes or batch imports.
manage.importRecommendation: Backup current data before importing to avoid accidental overwriting that is hard to rollback.
manage.syncRecommendation: If already logged in, prioritize confirming recent sync time and authorization scope are normal.
manage.shareRecommendation: Regularly clean up expired or unneeded shares to keep the share list tidy.
manage.aboutRecommendation: Putting common import/export or sync instructions here can significantly reduce misuse.
